caption: Alice signs two spends of the same 1 BTC, one to Bob and one to Carol. The network fixes one order, so one spend gets into a block and the other is rejected as already spent.

spec.aria: A message sequence in which Alice signs two spends of the same 1 BTC, one to Bob and one to Carol, both are broadcast to the network, and the network accepts the first into a block while rejecting the second as already spent.
